The plan having the smallest value for f is selected as the best plan, and the first Strategy in this plan is the next strategy that will be executed. This decision is recorded in the form of a “decision snapshot” that specifies the selected strategy along with the robot and user needs at the beginning of the decision-making cycle. This causal relationship between needs and active high-level behavior can be subsequently used for generating intention explanations and extended explanations based on intention and needs (see Section 4.3).
